source: Figma — final HEYDRU 2021 (Copy), BRANDBOOK page (Color Styles + COLORES frame)
notes: CMYK is only documented in the source for the 4 core colors (Red, Azul, Yellow, Black) — the other 8 exist only as Color Styles, no print breakdown given. Heydru-Black's HEX (#393A3E) is verified against the Color Style and against logo-dark.svg/favicon.svg; the source deck's own RGB text label for it (34,33,33) doesn't match that HEX and appears to be a typo in the original artwork, not a second valid value.

system.note: The source file lists 12 Color Styles as a flat set with no stated hierarchy or usage guidance. This grouping/ratio is our own addition (not from the 2021 source) — same idea as how mature brand systems (e.g. GitHub's: ~80% neutral, ~10% grey, ~10% hero green) assign roles so the palette reads as a system instead of 12 equal swatches.

neutral.use: surfaces, body text, structure — the dominant share of any layout

primary.use: the one hero color — CTAs, the icon mark, key emphasis. Never compete with it using a second saturated color in the same view.

accent.use: sparing use for variety, data visualization, or illustration — never as a substitute for the primary red on a CTA

derivedTints.note: Not in the source file — derived for product-UI needs (hover/active states, subtle backgrounds) that a 2021 print-oriented brandbook never had to specify. Already live on heydru.com as --hd-pink-hover.

Heydru-Red-hover.use: hover/active state for red CTAs/links — a ~10% darken of Heydru-Red

Heydru-Red-wash.use: subtle tinted background, e.g. a selected row or badge, where solid red would be too loud

Heydru-Red-wash-strong.use: hover state for the wash above

ramps.note: Not in the source file. 6-step tint/shade ramps computed in HSL off the verified base hex, same idea as GitHub's brand-toolkit color ramps. Named red-NNN/neutral-NNN, deliberately distinct from the named swatches above (Heydru-Red2, Heydru-gray3/4/5) to avoid confusion.

terminology.sintesisGrafica: icon mark alone, no wordmark (commonly called the isotipo)

logo.clearSpace: On all four sides of the marca gráfica, equal to one icon-mark's width/height, measured from the lockup's outer edges — per the source file's own guideline frames.

onDark.use: white wordmark, no icon, for dark backgrounds

onLight.use: Heydru-Black wordmark, no icon, for light backgrounds

alternateColors.note: Red is the default icon color (and the only one paired with white, for dark backgrounds). black/blue/yellow are real alternates shown in the source file's own color-variant grids (both the horizontal and the vertical one), always with black wordmark text where there's a wordmark — consistent across every form, not just one of them.

onDarkMonochrome.use: icon and wordmark both white — a separate, real option for single-ink/dark contexts, not a substitute for the two-tone onDark lockup

onDark.use: icon stacked above white wordmark, for dark backgrounds

onDarkMonochrome.use: icon and wordmark both white, icon stacked above — a separate, real option for single-ink/dark contexts

onLight.use: icon stacked above Heydru-Black wordmark, for light backgrounds

typography.source: Roboto only, per the source brandbook's own TIPOGRAFÍA PRINCIPAL frame

liveWebsitePairing.note: heydru.com currently pairs Poppins (headings) with Roboto (body). This pairing was introduced at website-build time and is not part of the original 2021 brandbook — recorded here as the de facto live choice, not as something verified against the source file.
